items.title: Coastal Modelling Engineer
items.summary: Development and application of advanced coastal morphodynamic models for long-term shoreline evolution under climate change scenarios.
bullets: Developed the coupled LX-ST model to simulate long-term shoreline morphological evolution
Integrated longitudinal and cross-shore sediment transport for comprehensive coastal modeling
Conducted multi-scenario simulations (SSP2-4.5, SSP5-8.5, High-End) for climate impact assessment
Applied the model to the Lacanau site (5 km) with sensitivity tests and varying erosion rates

items.title: Numerical Modeling of Coastline & Sandy Beaches under Sea-Level Rise
items.summary: Enhanced coastal modeling capabilities for climate change impact assessment on sandy coastlines.
bullets: Enhanced LX-Shore code with ShoreTrans module for improved accuracy
Developed 2D modeling capabilities for complex coastal geometries
Implemented sediment transport algorithms for long-term predictions
Validated models against observed coastal evolution data

items.title: Impact of Climate Change on Gironde Estuary Hydrodynamics
items.summary: Comprehensive hydrodynamic modeling study assessing climate change impacts on France's largest estuary.
bullets: Developed Telemac3D & Telemac2D models for flood and drought scenarios
Analyzed dredging impacts on estuarine circulation patterns
Performed hydrological modeling of Garonne & Dordogne rivers
Generated climate scenarios projections up to 2100
Contributed to national climate adaptation strategies
